root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `out` must remain live and caller-owned on the `err:` path; `rle_decode()` must not release it through `free(out)`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `rle_decode()` takes its `err:` path, it must return `NULL` without freeing the caller-provided output buffer `out`, because `decode_names()` still retains that same heap allocation in `ctx->desc[i].buf` for shared cleanup.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original violates this ownership-preservation obligation by executing `free(out)` on the `err:` path. The fixed original preserves the same caller-owned buffer and leaves `free_context()` as the first and only release.

nodes.description: `free_context()` later reaches `free(ctx->desc[i].buf)` on the tracked descriptor slot, so the sink call receives the same heap pointer that `rle_decode()` already released in the vulnerable run.

edges.relation: After `rle_decode()` reaches its `err:` cleanup for caller-owned `out`, `decode_names()` later enters `free_context()` with that same pointer still stored in `ctx->desc[i].buf`, so sink cleanup frees the already-released buffer again.
